# Export assay counts (dgCMatrix slots) + meta.data from a Seurat v3/v4/v5 .rds(.gz) WITHOUT Seurat or Matrix.
# usage: Rscript seurat_rds_export.R <src.rds.gz> <outdir> [assay=RNA]
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
src <- args[1]; out <- args[2]; assay <- ifelse(length(args) >= 3, args[3], "RNA")
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
read_any <- function(p) {
  r <- try(readRDS(gzcon(gzfile(p, "rb"))), silent = TRUE)       # doubly gzipped (library note)
  if (inherits(r, "try-error")) r <- readRDS(p)
  r
}
obj <- suppressWarnings(read_any(src))
cat("class:", class(obj), "\n")
assays <- attr(obj, "assays")
A <- assays[[assay]]
cat("assay class:", class(A), "\n")
M <- attr(A, "counts")
if (is.null(M)) {                                                  # Seurat v5 Assay5: layers$counts
  L <- attr(A, "layers"); M <- L[["counts"]]
}
dims <- attr(M, "Dim"); dn <- attr(M, "Dimnames")
if (is.null(dn[[1]])) dn[[1]] <- rownames(attr(A, "features"))
if (is.null(dn[[2]])) dn[[2]] <- rownames(attr(A, "cells"))
x <- attr(M, "x")
cat("dim:", dims, "nnz:", length(x), "int-valued:", all(abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-9), "\n")
writeBin(as.integer(attr(M, "i")), file.path(out, "i.int32.bin"), size = 4)
writeBin(as.integer(attr(M, "p")), file.path(out, "p.int32.bin"), size = 4)
writeBin(as.double(x), file.path(out, "x.float64.bin"), size = 8)
writeLines(as.character(dims), file.path(out, "dim.txt"))
writeLines(dn[[1]], file.path(out, "genes.txt"))
writeLines(dn[[2]], file.path(out, "cells.txt"))
md <- attr(obj, "meta.data")
write.csv(data.frame(cell = rownames(md), md), file.path(out, "meta.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("written", dims[2], "cells x", dims[1], "genes; meta", nrow(md), "\n")

"""VED-002 (GSE176306, Mesp1-Cre lineage-traced cardiac mesoderm, 10x, E7.25/E7.5/E7.75/E8.25).

Input: staging export of pbmc.combined@raw.data written by ved002_export.R (dgCMatrix slots, integer counts),
its meta.data and ident, and the author post-QC cell set (pbmc@data columns, 9,072 cells). Stage per cell comes
from the legacy stage identity (E720 / E750 / E775 / E825); a cell whose stage token cannot be read stays
UNRESOLVED. The reporter is a lineage label (Mesp1 lineage), not a perturbation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse

from ...paths import EXP, EXTERNAL
from ...provenance import sha256_file
from ..canonical import write_canonical
from ..selectors import RULE_ID, classify_interval, usage_roles

READER_VERSION = 'ved002-v1'
STAGING = EXP / 'cache' / 'staging' / 'VED-002'
SRC = EXTERNAL / '01_datasets/T1_Temporal/T1-02__VED-002__GSE176306/raw/official_geo/suppl/GSE176306_combined.Rdata.gz'


def _stage_from_token(tok):
    m = re.search(r'E(\d)(\d{2})', str(tok))
    if not m:
        return None
    v = float(f'{m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)}')
    # GEO GSM5362454 is staged E7.25 and holds 907 cells = exactly the RData 'E720' group: the official GEO stage wins
    return 7.25 if v == 7.20 else v


def run():
    nG, nC = [int(x) for x in open(STAGING / 'raw_dim.txt').read().split()]
    i = np.fromfile(STAGING / 'raw_i.int32.bin', dtype=np.int32)
    p = np.fromfile(STAGING / 'raw_p.int32.bin', dtype=np.int32)
    x = np.fromfile(STAGING / 'raw_x.float64.bin', dtype=np.float64)
    G = sparse.csc_matrix((x.astype(np.int32), i, p), shape=(nG, nC))
    X = G.T.tocsr()
    genes = [l.rstrip('\n') for l in open(STAGING / 'genes.txt')]
    cells = [l.rstrip('\n') for l in open(STAGING / 'cells.txt')]
    meta = pd.read_csv(STAGING / 'cells_meta.csv').set_index('cell').reindex(cells)
    ident = pd.read_csv(STAGING / 'ident.csv').set_index('cell').reindex(cells)['ident']
    postqc = set(l.rstrip('\n') for l in open(STAGING / 'postqc_cells_pbmc_data.txt'))
    # orig.ident is the uninformative 'SeuratProject'; the stage lives in the legacy ident (E720/E750/E775/E825)
    stage_tok = ident.astype(str)
    ages = [_stage_from_token(t) for t in stage_tok]
    # cross-check against the stage prefix carried in the cell name (E720_AAAC...)
    prefix_ages = [_stage_from_token(c.split('_')[0]) for c in cells]
    agree = float(np.mean([a == b for a, b in zip(ages, prefix_ages)]))
    win = [classify_interval(a, a) for a in ages]
    in_qc = np.array([c in postqc for c in cells])
    usable = in_qc & np.array([w != 'UNRESOLVED' and w != 'PROTECTED' for w in win])
    rows = np.flatnonzero(usable)
    sel_cells = [cells[r] for r in rows]
    sel_age = [ages[r] for r in rows]
    sel_win = [win[r] for r in rows]
    tok = [stage_tok.iloc[r] for r in rows]
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        'cell_uid': ['VED-002/' + t + '/' + c for t, c in zip(tok, sel_cells)], 'ved_id': 'VED-002', 'accession': 'GSE176306',
        'source_family_id': 'VEF-002', 'canonical_representation_id': 'VED-002#pbmc.combined@raw.data',
        'sample_id': tok, 'embryo_id': ['pool:' + t for t in tok], 'library_id': tok, 'biological_group_id': ['VED-002/' + t for t in tok],
        'stage_raw': tok, 'age_value': sel_age, 'age_lower': sel_age, 'age_upper': sel_age, 'age_unit': 'embryonic_day',
        'age_evidence': 'legacy Seurat ident (E720/E750/E775/E825), equal to the cell-name prefix', 'somite_count': 'unknown',
        'genotype_raw': 'Mesp1-Cre lineage reporter (WT background)', 'genotype_group': 'WT_lineage_traced', 'perturbation': 'none',
        'reporter': 'Mesp1-Cre lineage', 'sex': 'unknown', 'tissue': 'cardiac mesoderm (Mesp1 lineage)', 'dissection': 'embryo region',
        'enrichment': 'Mesp1 lineage (reporter sorted)', 'cell_or_nucleus': 'cell', 'assay': '10x Chromium',
        'source_celltype': 'not distributed (ident = stage)', 'source_major_cluster': 'unknown', 'value_semantics': 'raw_counts_integer',
        'normalization_id': 'none (counts)', 'gene_axis_id': f'VED-002#symbols{nG}', 'qc_flags': 'author post-QC set (pbmc@data)',
        'rule_snapshot_id': RULE_ID, 'window_status': sel_win, 'usage_role': [','.join(usage_roles(w)) for w in sel_win],
        'raw_path': str(SRC), 'duplicate_group_id': ['VED-002/' + c for c in sel_cells]})
    gdf = pd.DataFrame({'source_feature_id': genes, 'symbol': genes, 'observed': True})
    funnel = {'raw_columns': nC, 'meta_columns': list(meta.columns), 'stage_tokens': stage_tok.value_counts().to_dict(),
              'ident_vs_cellname_prefix_agreement': agree, 'author_postqc': int(in_qc.sum()),
              'window_counts_all_rows': pd.Series(win).value_counts().to_dict(), 'selected_rows': int(len(rows)),
              'selected_by_stage': pd.Series(tok).value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()}
    report = {'reader_version': READER_VERSION, 'source_file': str(SRC), 'source_sha256': sha256_file(SRC), 'rule_snapshot_id': RULE_ID,
              'staging_export': 'src/t1v1/data/readers/ved002_export.R (r_audit, no Matrix package; dgCMatrix slots)',
              'funnel': funnel, 'semantics_evidence': 'dgCMatrix raw.data, all values integer (checked in R export)'}
    out = write_canonical('VED-002', 'raw_counts', X[rows].astype(np.int32), df, gdf, report)
    print('VED-002', (len(rows), nG), funnel['selected_by_stage'], 'postqc', funnel['author_postqc'], 'meta cols', list(meta.columns)[:12], '->', out)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run()

# VED-002 (GSE176306) export: legacy Seurat v2 objects in a doubly gzipped RData.
# Reads pbmc.combined@raw.data (dgCMatrix) WITHOUT the Matrix package: the S4 slots i/p/x/Dim/Dimnames are read
# as attributes and written as raw binaries (reconstructed as CSC in Python). Read path follows
# audit/rdata_reader_compatibility_notes.md: load(gzcon(gzfile(...))), attributes read directly.
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
src <- args[1]; out <- args[2]
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
env <- new.env()
con <- gzcon(gzfile(src, "rb"))
suppressWarnings(load(con, envir = env))
try(close(con), silent = TRUE)
cat("objects:", paste(ls(env), collapse = ","), "\n")
obj <- get("pbmc.combined", envir = env)
raw <- attr(obj, "raw.data")
cat("raw.data class:", class(raw), "\n")
dims <- attr(raw, "Dim"); dn <- attr(raw, "Dimnames")
i <- attr(raw, "i"); p <- attr(raw, "p"); x <- attr(raw, "x")
cat("dim:", dims, "nnz:", length(x), "int-valued:", all(abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-9), "\n")
writeBin(as.integer(i), file.path(out, "raw_i.int32.bin"), size = 4)
writeBin(as.integer(p), file.path(out, "raw_p.int32.bin"), size = 4)
writeBin(as.double(x), file.path(out, "raw_x.float64.bin"), size = 8)
writeLines(as.character(dims), file.path(out, "raw_dim.txt"))
writeLines(dn[[1]], file.path(out, "genes.txt"))
writeLines(dn[[2]], file.path(out, "cells.txt"))
meta <- attr(obj, "meta.data")
write.csv(data.frame(cell = rownames(meta), meta), file.path(out, "cells_meta.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
id <- attr(obj, "ident")
write.csv(data.frame(cell = names(id), ident = as.character(id)), file.path(out, "ident.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
pq <- get("pbmc", envir = env)
pq_cells <- attr(attr(pq, "data"), "Dimnames")[[2]]
writeLines(pq_cells, file.path(out, "postqc_cells_pbmc_data.txt"))
cat("written", dims[2], "cells x", dims[1], "genes; meta rows", nrow(meta), "; postqc", length(pq_cells), "\n")

"""VED-012 (GSE193346, heart chambers LA/LV/RA/RV, 10x v3 + MULTI-seq, C57BL/6 and CD1 wild-type objects).

Staging export (seurat_rds_export.R, isolated R env with SeuratObject) of RNA counts + meta.data for the two WT
objects. Per cell: stage (E9.5 ... E18.5, P0-P9), zone (chamber), strain, batch, MULTI-seq sample.
Selected: exactly E9.5 (allowed) and > E13.5 (allowed with disclosure); postnatal = separate domain.
E10.5-E13.5 cells are PROTECTED: counted, never exported into the canonical layer.
Independence: a MULTI-seq sample is not called a biological replicate; the conservative biological group is
strain/stage/batch (chambers of one stage and batch may come from the same embryos).
The Tbx18/Wt1 KO objects are not read (conditional auxiliary only, DATA08).

v2 (D1, 2026-10-10): the authors' annotations in meta.data are read -- source_celltype = cell_type_spec
(atrial_cm, ventricular_cm, endocardial_ec, vascular_ec, fibroblast-like, epicardial, immune, blood) and
source_major_cluster = cell_type_broad; v1 had marked them 'not used'. Stage names are unified to one format,
'E<age with one decimal>' (E9.5, E14.5, ..., E18.0, E18.5) or 'P<day>' (P0 ... P9); the author string stays in
stage_literal ('E18' -> 'E18.0'). 'E18.0' (CD1, library E18P1) and 'E18.5' (C57BL6) are two real stages of two
strains; episodes never mix strains or chambers. Postnatal 'Pn' gets postnatal_day = n (own domain, never
interpolated with embryonic days).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse

from ...paths import EXP, EXTERNAL
from ...provenance import sha256_file
from ..canonical import write_canonical
from ..selectors import RULE_ID, USABLE, classify_interval, usage_roles

READER_VERSION = 'ved012-v2'
STG = EXP / 'cache' / 'staging' / 'VED-012'
SRC = EXTERNAL / '01_datasets/T1_Temporal/T1-12__VED-012__GSE193346/raw/official_geo/suppl'


def _age(stage):
    s = str(stage).strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r'P\d+', s):
        return None, None, True
    m = re.fullmatch(r'E(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)', s)
    if m:
        v = float(m.group(1)); return v, v, False
    return None, None, False


def _norm_stage(stage):
    """Unified stage name: 'E<age:.1f>' for embryonic stages, 'P<n>' for postnatal days ('E18' -> 'E18.0')."""
    s = str(stage).strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r'P\d+', s):
        return s
    m = re.fullmatch(r'E(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)', s)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f'unparsed VED-012 stage {s!r}')
    return f'E{float(m.group(1)):.1f}'


def load_staging(name):
    d = STG / name
    nG, nC = [int(x) for x in open(d / 'dim.txt').read().split()]
    i = np.fromfile(d / 'i.int32.bin', dtype=np.int32); p = np.fromfile(d / 'p.int32.bin', dtype=np.int32)
    x = np.fromfile(d / 'x.float64.bin', dtype=np.float64)
    X = sparse.csc_matrix((x.astype(np.int32), i, p), shape=(nG, nC)).T.tocsr()
    genes = [l.rstrip('\n') for l in open(d / 'genes.txt')]; cells = [l.rstrip('\n') for l in open(d / 'cells.txt')]
    meta = pd.read_csv(d / 'meta.csv', low_memory=False).set_index('cell').reindex(cells)
    return X, genes, cells, meta


def run():
    parts, metas, funnel = [], [], {}
    genes0 = None
    for name in ('CD1', 'C57BL6'):
        X, genes, cells, meta = load_staging(name)
        if genes0 is None:
            genes0 = genes
        assert genes == genes0, 'gene axes differ between objects'
        lo, hi, post = zip(*[_age(s) for s in meta['stage']])
        win = [classify_interval(a, b, p) for a, b, p in zip(lo, hi, post)]
        meta = meta.assign(age_lower=lo, age_upper=hi, postnatal=post, window_status=win, object=name)
        usable = meta['window_status'].isin(USABLE).to_numpy()
        funnel[name] = {'raw_columns': len(cells), 'window_counts': meta['window_status'].value_counts().to_dict(),
                        'protected_not_exported': int((meta['window_status'] == 'PROTECTED').sum()),
                        'selected': int(usable.sum()),
                        'selected_by_stage': meta.loc[usable, 'stage'].astype(str).value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()}
        parts.append(X[np.flatnonzero(usable)]); metas.append(meta[usable])
    X = sparse.vstack(parts).tocsr().astype(np.int32)
    m = pd.concat(metas).reset_index()
    age_val = [a if a == b else np.nan for a, b in zip(m['age_lower'], m['age_upper'])]
    grp = m['object'] + '/' + m['stage'].astype(str) + '/' + m['batch'].astype(str)
    cells = pd.DataFrame({
        'cell_uid': 'VEF-009/' + m['object'] + '/' + m['cell'].astype(str), 'ved_id': 'VED-012', 'accession': 'GSE193346',
        'source_family_id': 'VEF-009', 'canonical_representation_id': 'VED-012#' + m['object'] + '#RNA@counts',
        'sample_id': m['object'] + '/' + m['sample'].astype(str) + '/' + m['id'].astype(str), 'embryo_id': 'unknown (MULTI-seq sample; embryo not identified)',
        'library_id': m['batch'].astype(str), 'biological_group_id': grp, 'stage_raw': [_norm_stage(s) for s in m['stage']],
        'stage_literal': m['stage'].astype(str),
        'age_value': age_val, 'age_lower': m['age_lower'], 'age_upper': m['age_upper'],
        'age_unit': np.where(m['postnatal'], 'postnatal_day', 'embryonic_day'), 'age_evidence': 'author meta.data stage (literal)',
        'somite_count': 'unknown', 'genotype_raw': 'wildtype (' + m['object'] + ')', 'genotype_group': 'WT', 'perturbation': 'none',
        'reporter': 'none', 'sex': 'unknown', 'tissue': 'heart chamber', 'dissection': m['zone'].astype(str), 'enrichment': 'chamber microdissection',
        'cell_or_nucleus': 'cell', 'assay': '10x 3prime v3 + MULTI-seq',
        'source_celltype': m['cell_type_spec'].astype(str).where(m['cell_type_spec'].notna(), 'unlabelled'),
        'source_major_cluster': m['cell_type_broad'].astype(str).where(m['cell_type_broad'].notna(), 'unlabelled'),
        'postnatal_day': [float(s[1:]) if re.fullmatch(r'P\d+', str(s)) else np.nan for s in m['stage']],
        'value_semantics': 'raw_counts_integer', 'normalization_id': 'none (counts)', 'gene_axis_id': f'VED-012#RNA{len(genes0)}',
        'qc_flags': 'author QC-retained object', 'rule_snapshot_id': RULE_ID, 'window_status': m['window_status'],
        'usage_role': [','.join(usage_roles(w)) for w in m['window_status']], 'raw_path': [str(SRC / f'GSE193346_{o}_seurat_object.rds.gz') for o in m['object']],
        'duplicate_group_id': 'VED-012/' + m['cell'].astype(str), 'strain': m['strain'].astype(str), 'chamber': m['zone'].astype(str)})
    assert cells['cell_uid'].is_unique
    gdf = pd.DataFrame({'source_feature_id': genes0, 'symbol': genes0, 'observed': True})
    rep = {'reader_version': READER_VERSION, 'rule_snapshot_id': RULE_ID, 'funnel': funnel,
           'source_files': {o: sha256_file(SRC / f'GSE193346_{o}_seurat_object.rds.gz') for o in ('CD1', 'C57BL6')},
           'semantics_evidence': 'RNA@counts dgCMatrix, integer-valued (library audit VED-012#3/#6)',
           'staging_export': 'src/t1v1/data/readers/seurat_rds_export.R with env/r_seurat (SeuratObject)'}
    out = write_canonical('VED-012', 'wt_counts', X, cells, gdf, rep)
    print('VED-012', X.shape, funnel, '->', out)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run()
